recipe.title: Root Archive
recipe.tagline: A record vault grown from root fibre. On Dry Day 30 the water went to the seeds.
recipe.themeSummary: Twelve thousand seed jars at 4 degrees under a record vault of living root fibre. On Dry Day 30 Adjei sent the last 400 litres a day to the Seed Vault and the record roots went through the Index and Reading Room West for water.

rooms.name: Dry Path
rooms.description: Index couriers in satchel rigs run the flagstones from the far arch, two abreast. Lind's lanterns, 9 of them, mark the path; root crosses it in three places at ankle height.

rooms.name: The Index
rooms.description: Card terminals spray coolant across the aisles from the left, root through their tank housings. Reading Room patrons walk the stacks with their chairs still on them. Slip 4471 is pinned to the first cabinet.

rooms.name: Seed Vault
rooms.description: The vault door is a tree now, 3 m across, and it moves. Adjei is behind it at 4 degrees with 12,000 seed jars. Ten metres short of the door the ration tank plinth, drained, takes the Anchor.

lore.title: Order 7
lore.source: card pinned to the Reading Room West door
lore.text: ORDER 7. Dry Day 18. Ration tank draw: 400 litres. Seed Vault chillers: 360 litres. Reading wings, all: 40 litres. Patrons: 1 cup at opening. Reading Room West stays open. By order. B.A.

lore.title: Day book, Dry Day 22
lore.source: porter's day book, page marked with a lantern wick
lore.text: Dry Day 22. Closing 21:00: 30 patrons, all seated, none out. Mrs Halloway in seat 4 says she is on the last chapter. She has been on it since Day 15. Opening 07:00: 30 patrons, same seats. Lit 9 lanterns on the Dry Path. Root over the path at lanterns 3, 6 and 8, 2 m of it since last night, and my cup went in the ration tank untouched. T. Lind.

lore.title: Delivery slip 4471
lore.source: carbon slip pinned to the first Index cabinet
lore.text: SLIP 4471. Dry Day 26, 14:10. To: Seed Vault door. From: Index wing. Item: coolant, 20 litres, for the card terminals. Carried by: N. Farrow. Signature: refused. Reason given: "Order 7. Water does not pass this door in either direction." Time of refusal: 14:12. Coolant returned to the Index, 15:00. Slip not closed.

lore.title: Order 9
lore.source: card pinned over Order 7 on the Seed Vault door
lore.text: ORDER 9. Dry Day 30. Ration tank draw: 400 litres. Seed Vault chillers: 400 litres. Reading wings: nil. Index coolant: nil. Patrons: nil. Jars at 4 degrees: 12,000. By order. B.A.

lore.title: Day book, Dry Day 31
lore.source: porter's day book, last page written in
lore.text: Dry Day 31. Opening 07:00: 30 patrons, 30 seats, root up through every chair leg and into the seat. Mrs Halloway has turned a page. Lit 9 lanterns. Lantern 10 marks the end of the Dry Path and I did not light it, since the path has root on it from lantern 3. Locking up at 21:00 regardless. T. Lind.

lore.title: Slip 4490
lore.source: carbon slip, pencil, tucked under the ration tank lid
lore.text: SLIP 4490. Dry Day 34, 09:00. To: Seed Vault door. From: Well Head, H. Mbeki. Item: well reading, 0 m. Carried by: N. Farrow. Door: grown shut, bark to the lintel. Signature: none. Adjei answered through the door: "4 degrees. Hold." Slip 4471 still open. N.F.

lore.title: Reading-room chair, seat 4
lore.source: oak chair, root through all four legs
lore.text: Reading Room West chair, seat 4, Mrs Halloway's since Day 15. Lind's day book of Dry Day 31 has root up every leg and into the seat. The book on the arm is open at chapter 40 of 40.

lore.title: Satchel rig, Index wing
lore.source: canvas satchel on a shoulder frame, strap chewed
lore.text: Index courier satchel rig, frame number 12. Inside: 6 carbon slips, all with Signature: refused. The top one is slip 4471, coolant, 20 litres, Dry Day 26. Farrow wrote the refusal down word for word and underlined "either direction".

lore.title: Coolant tank, card terminal 9
lore.source: steel coolant tank, root through the drain plug
lore.text: Coolant tank off Index card terminal 9, 20 litres, empty. Order 9 put Index coolant at nil on Dry Day 30. Root came through the drain plug that night and the terminal has run hot since. It throws what coolant is left in the lines at 60 degrees.

lore.title: Bark from the Seed Vault door
lore.source: slab of bark, 4 cm thick, cold to the touch
lore.text: Bark off the Seed Vault door. Farrow logged the door grown shut on Dry Day 34 at 09:00 and the answer through it: "4 degrees. Hold." The bark is 4 degrees on the inside face. The well behind the Well Head read 0 m the same morning.

attunements.name: Seat 4
attunements.description: Melee and charge hits deal 25% less. Mrs Halloway held seat 4 in Reading Room West through 31 dry days and one chapter.

attunements.name: One Cup at Opening
attunements.description: Reading a relic restores 25 Integrity. Order 7 allowed each patron one cup from the ration tank at 07:00. Lind's went back in the tank.

attunements.name: Slip Not Closed
attunements.description: Recovering remains adds 40% ultimate charge. Farrow carried slip 4471 for 8 days and never got the signature. It is still in the rig.

attunements.name: Lantern 10
attunements.description: The first hit on an untouched enemy deals double. Lind lit 9 lanterns a night on the Dry Path and never lantern 10.

biomes.name: Dry Path

biomes.name: The Index
biomes.tagline: 400 card cabinets in aisles 1 m wide. 40 terminals, every coolant tank tapped.

biomes.name: Reading Room West
biomes.tagline: 30 seats, 30 patrons, one chapter left. The ration tank is by the door.

biomes.name: Well Head
biomes.tagline: Mbeki's pump house over a 2 m well, then a 0 m well. Coolant lines run hot here.

biomes.name: Courier Run
biomes.tagline: One corridor from the Index to the vault door. 6 satchel rigs on the floor.

biomes.name: Lantern Store
biomes.tagline: Lind's cupboard and the rooms behind it: 40 lanterns, 200 wicks, oil for a year.

biomes.name: Root Stacks
biomes.tagline: Where the records grow: 12 rows of root fibre, 3 m high, dry as paper.

biomes.name: Seed Vault
biomes.tagline: 12,000 jars at 4 degrees behind a door that is a tree. Adjei is inside.

bible.premise: The Root Archive is a record vault where documents are grown into living root fibre, with 12,000 seed jars kept at 4 degrees in the Seed Vault below.
bible.collapse: A drought took the well to 2 m on Dry Day 1 and pump engineer Hal Mbeki cut the supply to 400 litres a day. On Dry Day 30 chief archivist Berenike Adjei signed Order 9 and sent all 400 litres to the Seed Vault chillers. The record roots in the Index and Reading Room West grew 2 m a night toward the only water left: the terminal coolant tanks and the patrons.

people.name: Berenike Adjei
people.want: the 12,000 seed jars held at 4 degrees until the rains

people.name: Tomasz Lind
people.want: his 30 patrons out of Reading Room West by 21:00 closing

people.name: Ngozi Farrow
people.want: delivery slip 4471 signed so she can go home

events.fact: The well fell to 2 m and Mbeki cut the pump to 400 litres a day into the ration tank.
Adjei's Order 7 gave the reading wings 40 litres a day and the Seed Vault 360.
Lind counted 30 patrons in Reading Room West at closing and 30 at opening; root had crossed the Dry Path in the night, 2 m of it.
Farrow carried 20 litres of coolant for the Index terminals on delivery slip 4471 and had her signature refused at the Seed Vault door.
Adjei's Order 9 sent all 400 litres to the Seed Vault; by morning root had tapped every coolant tank in the Index.
Root reached Reading Room West; Lind's day book counts 30 patrons in their seats with root through the chair legs.
Mbeki found the well dry and the Seed Vault door grown shut, with Adjei inside at 4 degrees.

authors.name: Berenike Adjei
authors.register: Numbered orders. Litres, degrees, wing names. By order, then her initials. No reasons given.

authors.name: Tomasz Lind
authors.register: Patrons by name and seat number, lantern count, the time he locked up. One mild joke a page, about the patrons.
authors.never: writes the word root with a capital letter or a verb of its own

authors.name: Ngozi Farrow
authors.register: Recipient, item, weight, time, signature. One clause a line. Refusals recorded word for word.
authors.never: writes a sentence with two clauses

laws.name: Order 9
laws.description: Sight fails past 215 px from an operative; lanterns and conduits add light. Adjei's Order 9 cut the reading wings to nil, lamp oil included.

laws.name: Still in Their Seats
laws.description: A fallen enemy stands again after 11.5 s at 42% health unless an operative walks over its marker. Lind counted 30 patrons in Reading Room West every morning.

laws.name: Courier Pace
laws.description: Ability cooldowns are a third shorter and the ultimate charges 25% slower. Farrow ran the Index to the Seed Vault door in 4 minutes, 8 days in a row.

moves.name: Root draw
